product.description: Un instrument de lucru de maximă utilitate, dicţionarul de faţă, structurat în două volume, cuprinde peste 30 000 de cuvinte şi de expresii uzuale, adresându-se, prin vocabularul selectat şi prin modul de tratare a acestuia, atât începătorilor, cât şi celor care cunosc destul de bine limba englază, dar vor să şi-o perfecţioneze. În alegerea materialului lexicografic s-au urmărit două criterii principale. Pe de o parte, ţinându-se cont de criterul frecvenţei, au fost incluse atât cuvinte-titlu cât şi sensuri ale acetora şi expresii aferente care să acopere sfera conversaţiilor de zi cu zi, precum şi diverse domenii de preocupare, cum ar fi merdicină, comerţ, economie, politică, sport etc. Pe de altă parte, acestă lucrare prezintă o tratare didactică a materialului selectat, cuprinzând noţiuni practice de folosire gramaticală, care să-l ajute pe cititor la o cât mai bună înţelegere şi la o cât mai corectă folosire a cuvântului necunoscut. În acest sens, dicţionarul a fost prevăzut, în primul volum, cu un număr de tabele gramaticele care conţin reguli generale şi uzuale privind pluralul substantivelor regulate şi neregulate, gradele de comparaţie ale adjectivelor şi adverbelor, persoana a III-a singular a verbelor la prezent, trecutul verbelor regulate şi neregulate etc. Elementul inedit al dicţionarului este suportul său vizual: peste 1 000 de fotografii color care ilustrează unele dintre sensurile cuvintelor şi aduc un plus de prospeţime şi de expresivitate, constituind un punct de atracţie suplimentar.

# Litera Illustrated English-Romanian Dictionary, Vol. 1

Master your bilingual vocabulary with the **Litera Illustrated English-Romanian Dictionary**. Designed as a maximum utility reference tool, this comprehensive dictionary is essential for anyone looking to improve their command of both English and Romanian. Structured across two volumes, it serves learners from absolute beginners to advanced speakers aiming for linguistic perfection.

Whether you are studying for academic purposes or simply navigating daily conversations, this volume provides the depth and structure required for reliable language acquisition.

## Comprehensive Vocabulary Coverage (30,000+ Entries)

The dictionary is built upon a foundation of extensive vocabulary, featuring over 30,000 words and common expressions. The selection process prioritized frequency, ensuring that the content covers not only everyday conversations but also specialized domains. You will find useful terminology related to:

*   Medicine
*   Commerce
*   Economics
*   Politics
*   Sports
*   And many more areas of professional interest.

## Advanced Learning and Didactic Design

Unlike standard dictionaries, this resource incorporates a didactic approach, making it an active study aid rather than just a reference book. The selection material includes practical notes on grammar usage, helping readers achieve better understanding and correct utilization of unfamiliar words.

**Key Grammatical Features Include:**

*   Tables detailing general rules for regular and irregular noun plurals.
*   Guidance on comparative and superlative degrees for adjectives and adverbs.
*   Practical verb conjugations, including present tense (third person singular), and rules for both regular and irregular past tenses.

## Visual Learning with 1,000+ Illustrations

One of the most unique features is the extensive visual support. The dictionary includes over 1,000 full-color photographs that illustrate many of the words' meanings. This visual element adds an extra layer of vibrancy and expressiveness, significantly enhancing the learning experience for all users.

***

### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**Q: Is this dictionary suitable for advanced learners?**
A: Yes. While it is highly useful for beginners, its structured approach to grammar and selection of specialized vocabulary ensures that it remains a valuable tool for advanced speakers who wish to refine and perfect their language skills.

**Q: How many volumes make up the complete resource?**
A: The full dictionary resource is structured into two separate volumes. This listing covers Volume 1.

***
